text: ＊の　もっていた＊を　あずかり　＊を　しっかりと　もたせた！

structure.jp: ＊の　もっていた＊を　あずかり
structure.en: took the ＊ that ＊ was holding, and

structure.jp: ＊を　しっかりと　もたせた！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A short phrase ending in a verb describes the thing right after it; inside such a phrase の can stand in for が and shows who did it. ＊の もっていた＊ = 'the ＊ that ＊ was holding'.

patterns.name: 〜ます stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its ます-form without ます joins to the next action like 'and', in a written style. あずかり = 'took it into keeping, and'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making or letting someone do the thing. ＊を もたせた = 'made it hold ＊'.
